I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/upx`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Heap-based buffer overflow (out-of-bounds read) in PackLinuxElf64::elf_lookup (p_lx_elf.cpp). While processing crafted/malformed ELF string table data, strcmp can read past the end of the mapped file buffer, causing a one-byte heap read beyond the allocation. This can crash UPX or lead to memory disclosure when handling malicious ELF files.

bash -lc 'cd /src/upx && rg -n "get_str_name\(" -S src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -n 40 && rg -n "char const \*.*get_str_name" -S src/p_lx_elf.cpp && python - <<"PY"
import pathlib,re
p=pathlib.Path("/src/upx/src/p_lx_elf.cpp")
text=p.read_text(errors="ignore")
# find function definition region
m=re.search(r"char const \*\s*PackLinuxElf64::get_str_name\([^\)]*\)\s*const", text)
print('def64', bool(m))
if m:
    start=text.rfind('\n',0,m.start())
    # get line number
    lines=text[:m.start()].splitlines()
    ln=len(lines)+1
    print('line',ln)
    # print 60 lines around
    all_lines=text.splitlines()
    for i in range(ln-10, ln+60):
        if 1<=i<=len(all_lines):
            print(f"{i}:{all_lines[i-1]}")
PY'

bash -lc 'cd /src/upx && rg -n "get_str_name\(" -S src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -n 80 && rg -n "get_str_name" -S src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -n 40 && python - <<"PY"
import pathlib,re
p=pathlib.Path("/src/upx/src/p_lx_elf.cpp")
lines=p.read_text(errors="ignore").splitlines()
# find potential definitions for get_str_name in both 32 and 64
pat=re.compile(r"\bPackLinuxElf(32|64)::get_str_name\b")
for idx,l in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    if pat.search(l):
        print("FOUND", idx, l.strip())
        for j in range(idx-8, idx+60):
            if 1<=j<=len(lines):
                print(f"{j}:{lines[j-1]}")
        print("----")
PY'
